QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_15

question.text: Audit of which of the following PPM sections is OPTIONAL (not mandatory) under the annual PPM compliance audit framework for Cat I/II AIFs?

answer.text: Risk Factors, Legal/Regulatory/Tax Considerations, Track Record of First Time Managers, Illustration of Fees and Expenses, and Glossary and Terms.
Management fees charged for each class of units.
Capital commitments received and drawdowns made during the year.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** The PPM audit framework specifically carves out five OPTIONAL sections: 'Risk Factors', 'Legal, Regulatory and Tax Considerations', 'Track Record of First Time Managers', 'Illustration of Fees and Expenses', and 'Glossary and Terms'. All other sections — investment strategy implementation, drawdowns, fees actually charged, class-of-units compliance — remain mandatory. **The Trap:** Investment strategy implementation, management fees charged, and drawdowns received are explicitly listed as part of the mandatory scope. The correct option lists the PDF-cited optional carve-out. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same carve-out. Auditors often compile the optional list as a 'professional-opinion' addendum rather than a certified audit. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Even though risk factors and tax considerations are 'optional' audit-wise, keep a forensic change-log of those sections — they are the first pages a disgruntled LP's lawyer will mine for a misselling case.
